tldr: Oli backed Harry's handling of the SFTP/Ionic request with Lee's team, on the condition that they delete the data by end of Monday.

They agreed to coach that team by raising concerns once and letting them make non-damaging mistakes, and to take problems case by case.
Oli admitted dropping the ball on one-to-ones and asked Harry to raise concerns early and not vent late.
Harry's standalone data-processing repo and the new tiered GCP VM were shown. Laptop upgrades will be justified case by case.
decisions: Coach the Bifrost team by raising concerns once, then letting them make non-damaging mistakes, handled case by case.
Give better hardware only where a need is shown, not to everyone by default.
Oli will take the issue with Ollie directly, and the working relationship with the team continues with a reset and more care.
